candidateDescription: The candidate sprite is an orange fox with a bushy tail, identical in design to the original Coco reference fox.
observations: (1) The requested species is a turtle; the candidate clearly depicts an orange fox with a bushy tail — the wrong animal entirely.
(2) The artwork itself has deliberate outlines, shading, highlights and facial details matching Coco's polish, so art quality is not the issue.
(3) The fox silhouette reads clearly against the game scene background with good contrast.
(4) The crouch frame shows a low, elongated fox body that is recognizable as a crouch pose.
defects: Wrong species: the candidate is a fox, not a turtle — the entire character must be redrawn as a turtle with shell, short limbs, and turtle head to satisfy the request.
No turtle-specific features (domed shell, scaly skin, stubby neck) are present anywhere in the sprite sheet or game scene.
The crouch frame must also be redesigned to reflect a turtle crouching or retracting into its shell, not a fox lying flat.
